capabilities: Set a vault-wide Mermaid layout engine (ELK or Dagre) and node placement
Configure edge corner styles and node/layer spacing
Run ELK layout in a Web Worker so diagram rendering does not freeze the editor
Re-render diagrams in open notes with a command
Override layout settings per diagram on its first line
extras: ELK (~2.6 MB) is bundled into main.js and loads only when a diagram is first shown; the plugin makes no network requests and is manually installed from GitHub releases rather than the community plugin store.
intentEvidence: sets how Mermaid diagrams are laid out across your vault: the ELK layout engine with right-angle edges
problem: Obsidian offers no settings to change how Mermaid diagrams are laid out, so every vault is stuck with the default Dagre layout and its default spacing.

relations.evidence: merges its settings into Mermaid's configuration after Obsidian has initialised it

summary: Vault-wide Mermaid settings plugin that sets diagram layout to the ELK engine with right-angle edges, plus edge and spacing options.
